name: BioC-Check

on: [push, pull_request]

jobs:
  bioc-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: bioconductor/bioconductor_docker:devel
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Dependencies
        run: |
          Rscript -e "options(repos = BiocManager::repositories()); remotes::install_deps(dependencies = TRUE)"
          Rscript -e "BiocManager::install(c('BiocCheck', 'testthat', 'knitr', 'rmarkdown'))"
      - name: Build and Check
        run: |
          Rscript -e "rcmdcheck::rcmdcheck(args = '--no-manual', error_on = 'error')"
          Rscript -e "BiocCheck::BiocCheck('.')"
